footprints.description: E-Switch TL6340 sealed right-angle SMD tactile switch, 3.85 x 1.95 mm body, 2 terminals
footprints.note: TL6340.pdf p.2 Recommended Surface Mount PCB Layout, drawn as printed (front edge at the top; it is the top view turned 180 deg, so terminal 1 is on the left): terminals 1, 2 pads 0.70 x 1.10, inner edges 0.08 outside the dia 0.60 peg centres 3.65 apart, so x = +/-1.395; pad tops 0.40 below the bracket pads (1.65 - 0.15 - 1.10), i.e. 0.80 behind the peg centre (the dia 0.80 ring around each peg touches the bracket-pad edge). Not drawn: the two 1.15 x 1.35 bracket pads with dia 0.60 peg holes and the 1.40 x 1.10 centre bracket pad. Body 3.85 x 1.95 (2.90 with the 0.95 actuator); side view: peg 1.55 behind the actuator tip, i.e. 0.60 behind the front face.
